in_marathi.name: Archit
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Measuring or Architect
in_marathi.long_meaning: Archit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Archit is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘archana’ meaning ‘to worship’. It is also associated with the god Agni, the god of fire, and the architect of the universe. The name symbolizes creativity, intelligence, and the power to shape and design one's own destiny.
